env.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU

prompts.C1: Find every instance of "{q}" in this image. Return JSON only, no prose: {{"objects": [{{"bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}}]}} with integer coordinates normalized to 0-1000 relative to image width and height. If there is no such object, return {{"objects": []}}.
prompts.C6: Numbered candidate boxes are drawn on this image. Which numbered boxes contain "{q}"? Select every box that contains it and no other box. Return JSON only, no prose: {{"ids": [<numbers>]}}. If no box contains it, return {{"ids": []}}.

image_space: raw (distorted) camera pixels, 1920x1080, x right, y down, origin top-left. Undistortion is NOT applied in this experiment; geometry converts selected points later.
